messages:
Anita Gomez: Hey team — ACME Health POC just asked for firm pricing. Requirements: HIPAA + SOC2, HSM (customer-managed BYOK), audit logs retained for 7 years, private deployment. They are proposing a 12mo commit, ~$60k/mo. Can we offer 25% off for the commit and include compliance add-on? Need deal-desk eyes.

Josh Patel: Quick sketch to start: recommend Private + Dedicated (for isolation) + HSM add-on + compliance package. Rough numbers (ballpark):
```
- Dedicated base: $28,000/mo (8x A100-equivalent)
- Compliance package (SOC2+HIPAA attestation, audit logs, encryption controls): $8,000/mo
- HSM integration (one-time professional services): $18,000
- Long-term audit log storage: est $0.08/GB/mo (7yr retention cost scales)
```
With a 12mo commit we typically give ~10-12% commit discount. 25% would require deal-desk approval or higher commit. Also note HSM BYOK has extra ops cost.

Ryan O'Neill: FYI deal-desk rules: up to 20% can be approved at director level for enterprise commits >= $50k/mo ARR. Anything >20% requires VP approval. Options: increase commit band (e.g., 100k+/mo) to justify 25% or keep 20% and offer 1 month onboarding free. HSM one-time PS should remain billable — cannot be waived without exec sign-off.

Anita Gomez: Got it. Customer specifically called out 7yr retention as non-negotiable (regulatory). They'll accept larger commit if we can hit 25%. Need a clear quote to show to procurement today. Can we get a 'best-effort' quote to share? :eyes:

Sara Liu: Security/legal notes: SOC2 + HIPAA package requires updated DPA and attestation process; onboarding ~4–6 weeks. 7-year retention has data residency implications — must include storage sizing and legal sign-off on retention policy. We should add a clause: long-term log retention billed separately and subject to data export rules. Loop in compliance@redwood.

deal-bot: Deal tagged: enterprise_compliance | approval_needed: discount>20% | owner: Anita Gomez

Josh Patel: I'll produce a formal quote doc with two options:
- Option A (standard): 12mo commit $60k/mo, 12% commit discount, compliance pkg + HSM PS, total TCV = calc.
- Option B (accelerated): 12mo commit $100k/mo => eligible for 25% discount, waive 1x onboarding fee OR apply credit towards HSM PS (needs Ryan/VP sign-off).
I'll include per-GB estimates for 7yr retention and call out SLA/onsite support as add-ons.

Ryan O'Neill: Sounds good. Quick decision matrix for Anita to present:
- 20% discount = director approval, keeps HSM fee
- 25% = requires VP if commit <100k/mo; auto-approve if >=100k/mo (sales policy)
- We can offer a capped storage credit for first 6 months if they commit to 12mo but not >20% discount.

Anita Gomez: I'll push both options to ACME procurement and ask if they can move to $100k/mo to unblock 25%. Will update here after call at 11:30 PT. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Josh Patel: I'll draft quote and include a technical appendix for HSM integration steps and expected timeline (we'll need their HSM vendor certs).

Sara Liu: Also call out that any SOC2/HIPAA attestation exceptions must be tracked in the security exceptions log and signed off by compliance.

Ryan O'Neill: If Anita gets verbal that they can hit $100k, ping me and I'll fast-track VP approval. If not, we'll aim for 20% + onboarding credit and standard PS.

Anita Gomez: Update — ACME asked if we can provide storage estimate template. Josh, can you include a simple calc per TB for 7 years in the quote?

Josh Patel: Will do. Example to include: `7yr retention = 84 months * 1024 GB/TB * $0.08/GB/mo => ~$6,900/TB over 7 years` (ballpark). I'll attach a spreadsheet.

Anita Gomez: Perfect. Back after the call.
